Fantastic experience at Sino Dent!
I have just had a fantastic experience at Sino Dent in Phuket. The staff were incredibly friendly and professional from start to finish. They took the time to explain the treatment and I felt comfortable throughout. The clinic was clean and modern and I was impressed with the high level of service. I would highly recommend Sino Dent to anyone needing dental treatment in Phuket.

5 stars from denmark

Thank you so much to all the doctors and staff who took good care of me! The clinic is simple, but everything is clean, and they have a nice drawing on the wall.
I came with a difficult case and they helped me. Thanya and a few colleagues spoke English and we could find a solution for my case. They were tolerant and very polite. Sadly I don’t know the names of the doctors who attended me in the end, but the work was fast, gentle and now I can smile again:)
Thank you so much:)

Excellent service. Dr. Bank is very thorough and meticulous, not overlooking even the smallest details. The assistants are friendly and the teamwork is superb. The atmosphere is relaxing, and there are even photo opportunities. It's a one-stop shop for both photos and teeth cleaning. You'll leave with clean, white teeth. Highly recommend Sino Dent.

Everything was great, doctor. The dental work was excellent; I'm very satisfied. However, the front desk staff were very impolite. They swept the trash in front of customers without apologizing beforehand. This needs improvement. They should pay more attention to customer service. Thank you.
